name: Inbox Scout
tagline: Each morning your unread mail comes back sorted: needs-you, can-wait and noise
description: Each morning it reads the last day of unread mail and sorts it into three buckets: needs you, can wait, and noise. Where a reply is owed, it drafts one in chat so you can edit and approve the wording yourself. Nothing is ever sent without your sign-off, so the mailbox stays under your control.
author: AdeptusMec71933
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
